column1: # Board game terms, English → Finnish, one "english<TAB>finnish" pair per line ("#" starts a comment).
# Used by the server-side engines: as a DeepL glossary (DeepL inflects the Finnish term to fit the
# sentence) and in the language model's prompt. Lowercase base forms. DeepL applies an entry wherever the
# English phrase occurs, so avoid words with other everyday meanings ("die", "turn"): use phrases.
